critical_code_review_comments: combat_bridge._build_party places every party member at x=0 with y=i%HEIGHT; if the party ever grows past HEIGHT (=6) two units would overlap at (0,0). Companion loop already breaks when y>=HEIGHT but the hero placement uses (0, i%HEIGHT) where i=0 -> (0,0). Safe today (party<=HEIGHT) but worth a guard when threat-budget scaling arrives.

combat_bridge._apply_results forces ws_player['hp']=1 if the computed value <=0 EVEN when outcome=='player'. Practically fine (victory can't happen with hp<=0 in engine), but the explicit floor at 1 also swallows a genuine 'pyrrhic 0hp survival'. Consider: on victory keep the actual hp (which will be >0 since hero is alive); on defeat/draw floor to 1 as anti-softlock. Currently softlock guard is applied uniformly.

combat_bridge.start_encounter mutates bf.tile(0, i%HEIGHT).occupant=None before the engine start-placement — this is a no-op comment ('placement handled by engine.start') but the explicit .occupant=None can be removed to avoid confusion.

biome 'urban' (kingdom_capital) falls through to the default 'roadside_ambush' — intentional per BIOME_GROUPS, but there's no 'urban' key so any city region silently gets bandits. If cities should have their own group (city_watch/city_thugs) this is a content gap, not a bug.

world_actions.explore_menu docstring still says 'Combat is intentionally untouched: encounters are launched through the existing combat.quick_encounter entry point' — the code was updated but the module docstring wasn't. Stale doc-comment; low priority.
